blocks.heading: What it is
blocks.body:
V is for Victims is a brand new musical comedy — a murder mystery in the tradition of Agatha Christie, twisted through the modern comic misdirection of Rian Johnson's Knives Out films, with a score of original songs nobody's heard before.

It builds on the company's history of pantomimes without being one — the same appetite for a room having a good time together, aimed at a proper theatrical whodunit rather than panto conventions.

blocks.heading: From the company
blocks.quote: We wanted to write the show we'd want to watch: a real whodunit, played completely straight until it isn't, with songs nobody's heard before. Christie gave us the shape; Rian Johnson gave us permission to have this much fun with it.

blocks.heading: Venue & tickets
blocks.body:
V is for Victims is coming in 2027 — scripting and songwriting are underway before anything is scheduled to be seen.

Join the mailing list to hear about workshop showings, casting, and eventually dates and venue, as soon as any of it is confirmed.

items.question: Is this a pantomime?
items.answer: No — it builds on our history of pantomimes, but V is for Victims is a full musical comedy in its own right, not a panto.

items.question: What's the story?
items.answer: A murder mystery in the tradition of Agatha Christie, with the comic misdirection of Rian Johnson's Knives Out films — brand new songs throughout.

items.question: When will it be staged?
items.answer: 2027. We're still writing and workshopping — join the mailing list to hear about casting, dates and venue as soon as any of it is confirmed.

items.question: Will there be a workshop showing?
items.answer: Likely, before a full run — details TBC. This is usually how we test new work before committing to a venue.
